citation.authors: Michau C, Osei L, Elenga N, Delion F et al

cited_by.title: Lupus: symptoms, risk and getting diagnosed early

record.population: 27 children with lupus nephritis of Afro-descendant background, French Overseas Departments of America, 2000 to 2024
record.finding: Mean age at diagnosis 11.3 years; 55% had kidney involvement at diagnosis and 75% had class III or IV disease. Kidney flares were more frequent under age 12. Six (22%) had eGFR under 60 at last follow-up, two on dialysis and two transplanted. The authors say outcomes showed higher dialysis and kidney failure than Caucasian series.
record.note: Small case series, children only; comparison is with other published series, not a matched group.
